query: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow select for public" ON koda_users; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow update for public" ON koda_users; CREATE POLICY "Users can select own profile" ON koda_users FOR SELECT USING (id::text = (auth.jwt() ->> 'sub')); CREATE POLICY "Users can update own profile" ON koda_users FOR UPDATE USING (id::text = (auth.jwt() ->> 'sub')); DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow public select tickets" ON support_tickets; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow public insert tickets" ON support_tickets; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow public update tickets" ON support_tickets; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Admins can read all tickets" ON support_tickets; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow public select messages" ON support_ticket_messages; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow public insert messages" ON support_ticket_messages; CREATE POLICY "Users can read own ticket messages" ON support_ticket_messages FOR SELECT USING ( ticket_id IN (SELECT id FROM support_tickets WHERE reporter_uuid = (auth.uid())::text) ); CREATE POLICY "Users can insert own ticket messages" ON support_ticket_messages FOR INSERT WITH CHECK ( ticket_id IN (SELECT id FROM support_tickets WHERE reporter_uuid = (auth.uid())::text) AND sender_uuid = (auth.uid())::text ); DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow all for high risk" ON high_risk_hwids; CREATE POLICY "Allow public read access" ON high_risk_hwids FOR SELECT USING (true); DROP POLICY IF EXISTS "Allow insert for servers public" ON koda_servers; CREATE POLICY "Users can insert own servers" ON koda_servers FOR INSERT WITH CHECK ((owner_app_uuid)::text = (auth.jwt() ->> 'sub'::text));
